shipLog.text: ◆ Docking at station. MARV notes that stations are where people who stopped traveling sell things to people who haven't yet. He has not decided which group is wiser.
◆ Seeds in medium. MARV notes the crop is the only passenger aboard expected to produce something. He has adjusted his expectations of the others accordingly.
Arrived: FSS Due Diligence. The leg cost +2 MORALE, −2 FUEL, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
Departure Protocol. The captain chose “Check the crop one last time before departure”. Noted.
The crop is fine. +2 MORALE, 1 DAY. It will not last.
◆ Approaching the derelict. Once, someone looked at this ship the way you look at ours. MARV mentions this only because nobody else will.
Arrived: New Somewhere. The leg cost +2 MORALE, −2 FUEL, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (1/3). The colony office will want this.
Soil Sample Paradise. The captain chose “Survey for water sources”. Noted.
Subsurface ice detected and extracted. +5 H2O, 2 DAYS. It will not last.
◆ Planetary approach. Gravity well, atmosphere, biosphere-adjacent readings. MARV lists these as hazards. He is technically correct, which is his favorite kind.
▶ TRADER SHIP ON APPROACH
Arrived: Outpost Remember-To-Buy-Fuel. The leg cost +2 MORALE, −2 FUEL, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
A Commercial Opportunity. The captain chose “Trade pleasantries and move on”. Noted.
You swap route gossip and weather reports — there is no weather, but… +2 MORALE, 1 DAY. It will not last.
Market Row. The captain chose “BACK TO DOCK”. Noted.
1 DAY. It will not last.
Station Inbound. The captain chose “LEAVE STATION”. Noted.
Nothing aboard changed. It will not last.
◆ The station captain pings the comms once on your way out: “Safe burns out there, captain. The ring'll still be here next pass.”
◆ We departed Earth orbit with every item technically fine. I have been watching ‘technically’ erode ever since.
Tomato: VEGETATIVE. 28% grown, health 87. Temporarily.
◆ GROWBAY ALERT — pest outbreak detected. TREAT from the growbay before it compounds.
◆ GROWBAY — pest outbreak treated.
Arrived: Technically Habitable. The leg cost +5 CROP, +2 MORALE, −2 FUEL, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (2/3). The colony office will want this.
◆ The ship computer notes that more events have been logged about the tomatoes than about the hull. It does not editorialize. (+5 crop health)
The Previous Tenants. The captain chose “Check the old water channel”. Noted.
The channel still runs, nine hundred years on — spring-fed… +7 H2O, 2 DAYS. It will not last.
Arrived: Route Decision. The leg cost −3 FOOD, −3 H2O, +2 MORALE, −2 FUEL, +4 CROP, −1 O2, 8 DAYS. Filed.
◆ A tomato has fallen off the vine. Three crew members have opinions about this. (+5 crop health)
Right of Way. The captain chose “Port lane — the starboard beacon is the faulty one”. Noted.
You go port. 1 DAY. It will not last.
Tomato: FLOWERING. 52% grown, health 100. Temporarily.
Arrived: That One With The Rings. The leg cost +2 MORALE, −2 FUEL, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (3/3). The colony office will want this.
Uninvited Company. The captain chose “Flee”. Noted.
You pour the reserves into the engines. −8 FUEL, 2 DAYS. It will not last.
◆ A planet. MARV notes that every problem the crew has had in space was originally invented on one of these.
▶ TRADER SHIP ON APPROACH
Arrived: Second Choice Prime. The leg cost +2 MORALE, −2 FUEL, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
◆ MARV files a note on what looking back at everything from far away does to crews. The effect has a name.
The Middle. The captain chose “Mark it — small ceremony, real juice”. Noted.
The crew assembles at the viewport for the equator crossing. +5 MORALE, 1 DAY. It will not last.
◆ A planet. MARV observes that it has been doing perfectly well without us. He does not expect that to continue.
Tomato: MATURING. 75% grown, health 100. Temporarily.
◆ The crop is mature. MARV notes this is statistically better than average for this point in the journey. He files this as 'acceptable.'
◆ The ship computer notes tomatoes have real flight heritage: grown aboard the ISS in the Veggie experiment.

link.label: Veggie: growing food on the ISS

shipLog.text: Arrived: Nebula (alpha). The leg cost +2 MORALE, −2 FUEL, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
Vessel Approaching. The captain chose “Fight — bring weapons online”. Noted.
Vessel Approaching. Won. −15 HULL, +5 MORALE, +5 GOLD, 4 DAYS. The universe will invoice us later.
◆ The tomatoes have opinions about the humidity level. They have communicated this by wilting performatively.
